integrity_note: The upper path witness for arbitrary indices and the small-index minimality computations for indices 1 through 3 were known in the motivating source. The present claim is the uniform global lower bound, half-world stabilization, and exact all-index optimum; finite enumeration corroborates but does not prove the infinite family. Priority beyond the inspected literature is not certified.
scientific_limitations: Finite single-relation Kripke frames and the exact variable-free iteration \(lpha_{r+1}=\Box\Diamondlpha_r\). No corresponding bound is asserted for arbitrary modal formulas, variable modalities, or infinite frames. Path witnesses rely on nonserial worlds.
title: A sharp half-world cutoff for iterated \(\Box\Diamond\top\) on finite Kripke frames
